turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS metric; the closest metrics are Booking value (EUR) and Ad spend (EUR), which for 1 to 30 September 2026 came to EUR 128,900 and EUR 6,270 respectively, and I did not compute a ratio from them. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
